content: I got $10 off my first hotel and flight booking with their promo “𝙎𝙁𝙑𝟮𝙅𝙌”, maybe it still works. I’ve been using the Trip travel app for most of my trips and it’s been really convenient for flights, hotels and even data plans. As my membership grows I keep unlocking more discounts and perks like lounge access. When I combine it with my travel credit cards, the rewards add up fast, so I always tell friends to book through Trip. Over all thank you for this pretty amazing app!

Very helpful app.Thanks to it I was able to easily by an eSIM, book different trips and buy tickets.Used it to book a safari trip in Bangkok and was very pleased with everything. Easy to purchase and then was separately contacted through WhatsApp to discuss all the details.Thank you to the team for such wonderful work🤗

The app itself is fine to use, the addition of social media type features was unnecessary but all apps in China do it I guess…the ‘dynamic pricing’ for airline tickets is BS and should be banned! Also can you pleeease put the flight tracking button somewhere on home page? It’s a very useful feature and should be instantly accessible.
review_title: Put flight tracking on home page!

content: I booked a hotel for a few days through this company. The voucher they sent me after I had booked said I would only owe the hotel a few dollars ($17) for taxes/fees. Hotel never got the money from this company so they ended up charging me directly for the full price ($600+ for the room including parking). If I hadn’t been tracking my expenses I would have missed the double charge. When I filed a dispute with this company, they gave me the run around for about two weeks then told me the $600+ they charged me did not include parking and they would only reimburse me my money less about $120 for parking. Why would it’s cost about the same for booking with this company and paying at the hotel directly when booking through this company dose not include the parking. I’m guessing that’s how they get their cut, make like they are giving you a good deal, then tell you later that parking was not include, betting on you never actually knowing how much it would have really cost you if you book directly with the hotels. Could have just payed directly at the hotel and save myself $120. What a rip off!
review_title: “ I could have paid directly to the hotel and save myself $120 and the run around”

content: I’ve spent so much money on this stupid platform because it’s the most foreigner friendly one for bookings in China. I recently had a terrible hotel experience, so I had to request a refund as I didn’t stay the night and booked a different one. I filed a chargeback with my bank, but was able to solve the issue with trip and received a refund. But because I filed a chargeback they blocked my account. I’ve had to make all my hotel booking, attraction bookings etc. using different platforms for wechat miniprograms directly with the merchants. I’ve provided so much proof that the chargeback was reversed: an official letter from my bank, and the chargeback credit reversal. Yet the refuse to lift this block. I will NEVER use this platform again. I can’t believe this is happening. I can’t even make another account because if a booking requires my passport number they automatically block my transaction after inputting that information. Horrible customer support. I’m livid, don’t they want to make money?

First time I used this platform, I ended up in a roach-infested hotel. Second time, I made sure to pay more and double-check everything. I was at the airport two hours before my flight when the plane had a mechanical failure. I received no compensation and was left completely stranded.Update: I decided to give them another chance. My itinerary clearly shows I arrive in Vientiane at 21:45 on February 17 due to an overnight transfer. That information is right there in the booking. Yet the hotel was scheduled from February 16, when I wasn’t even in the country.It makes no sense to charge for a night that was impossible for me to use based on the flight schedule included in the same package. From my perspective, that’s being charged for nothing.I’m not going to pursue this any further. I’ll take the loss. But this will be the last time I use this platform.
